sources.snippet: ClawGym: A Scalable Framework for Building Effective Claw Agents ClawGym is a scalable framework for synthesizing data, training agents, and evaluating Claw-style personal agents in local, stateful workspaces. 👨‍💻 This project is developed by RUC AI Box.
